stem: Which of these best describes the purpose of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: To show differences between the way eye surgery is performed in the East and in the West

options.label: B
options.text: To celebrate the work of an eye surgeon in India and describe the author's experience as a volunteer

options.label: C
options.text: To encourage eye surgeons throughout the world to model their methods after those used by Dr. V

options.label: D
options.text: To describe the success of the technological breakthrough developed by Dr. V at Aravind Eye Hospital
